name: hashtagweb3-mcp-server
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Hashtag Web3. Exposes live Web3 job search, blockchain glossary definitions, crypto news, and event listings as callable tools for AI assistants and agents.

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search verified Web3, DeFi, and blockchain jobs by keyword, company, or technology tag.

tools.name: search_glossary
tools.description: Query 200+ technical blockchain, DeFi, and Web3 glossary definitions.

search.description: Term or concept to lookup (e.g. Zero Knowledge, AMM)

tools.name: get_news
tools.description: Retrieve the latest Web3 and crypto headlines.

tools.name: get_events
tools.description: List upcoming Web3 conferences, hackathons, and crypto summits.

search.description: Search by event name or city

resources.name: Web3 Jobs Directory UI
resources.description: Interactive UI showing the latest Web3 and blockchain job listings.

resources.name: Web3 Glossary UI
resources.description: Interactive UI directory for Web3 concepts, terms, and definitions.

resources.name: Crypto News UI
resources.description: Interactive UI feed for the latest crypto news headlines.

resources.name: Web3 Events Calendar UI
resources.description: Interactive calendar listing upcoming blockchain and crypto conferences.

resources.name: Latest Web3 Jobs (JSON)
resources.description: Structured JSON payload of the most recent verified Web3 job postings.

resources.name: Web3 Technical Glossary (JSON)
resources.description: Structured JSON dictionary of 200+ blockchain and cryptographic terms.

resources.name: Hashtag Web3 Documentation & Guides (Markdown)
resources.description: Complete documentation for developers, agent integration, and career guides.
